title: 准备服务连接凭证
summary: 为当前沙箱准备执行用户的首选 GitLab HTTPS 凭证。
description: Use conn_id returned by git_repo_list before authenticated Git operations. One credential is shared by worktrees using that connection. Supports GitLab access tokens only.
result_description: conn_id and ready. Remote repository permissions are enforced by GitLab.
